candidate.description: CROWN - a per-ticker crown registry and Uniswap v4 fee hook. Build the full system, deploy it on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663), and deliver a working end-to-end demo. CONCEPT: One canonical token per ticker - the king. A registry contract maps ticker -> {kingToken, beneficiary, reignStartedAt}. A Uniswap v4 hook attached to participating pools ...
